task_title: Scope conflict coordination and synchronize authoring branches

plan_review.notes: Adopted activity-aware cadence guard that accumulates bounded intervals between agent tool calls and attempts sync after 30 active minutes; dirty worktrees warn until checkpointed. Cleanup candidates now union all four coordinator labels plus trusted managed comments and only grouped eligible members retain labels. Pre-publish branch changes emit validation-invalidated warnings and instructions require final validation after sync. PR preflight keeps deny reasons and sync warnings separate, including mixed outcomes. No different architecture required.
